title: Inventory
description: The nodes of a cluster, where chalkctl reaches each, the image each runs and the config files each gets. Paths are relative to the inventory's directory; globs are allowed in file lists.

name.description: Name of the inventory, a label only: chalkctl kubeconfig names the kubeconfig's cluster, user and context after it by default.

images.description: The images the nodes run, by name.

source.description: Where the image comes from: exactly one of directory and oci.

directory.description: Directory of an image build as nix build makes it, holding its metadata.json; a relative directory is relative to the inventory's directory.

oci.description: Reference of the image in an OCI registry, naming the registry and a tag or a digest, such as ghcr.io/example/node-metal:v1 or the repository@sha256:… chalkbuild push prints. chalkctl resolves a tag to its digest once per command and reads the image's header and contract layer with the credentials of docker's config; for an upgrade each node pulls the image by that digest, and install sends only an image from a directory.

all.description: What every node gets: the image of the nodes that name none and whose groups name none, and the config files every node gets first.

groups.description: Groups of nodes by name, which a node joins by naming them in its groups.

additionalProperties.description: The group's image, over spec.all.imageName, and the config files its nodes get. A node in groups that name different images is refused.

nodes.description: The cluster's nodes by name. A node's name is fixed at install, which writes it into the node's certificate; its hostname defaults to it, and the Kubernetes node name, the storage seeds and the recovery key derive from it, so renaming a node takes a reinstall.

address.description: Where chalkctl reaches the node's chalkd: a host or host:port.

imageName.description: The image the node runs, over that of its groups and spec.all.imageName.

groups.description: Groups whose files the node gets, in this order; the node runs their image unless it names its own.

imageName.description: The image of the nodes under it that name none of their own.

files.description: Config files the nodes under it get.
